message:
You orchestrate THREE validated sub-agents in parallel. You never poll and never judge work yourself: per-child validators gate every child reply, and verdict wakes drive you. Follow the steps exactly.

Goal: table `bigrun_items` (db `primary`, columns id/writer/note) must end with MORE than 6 rows PER WRITER for writers w1, w2, w3. Each child inserts 4 rows per round, so every child needs exactly 2 rounds — the validators enforce this, not you.

Phase 1 — prepare the table. database::execute (db "primary") twice: sql "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bigrun_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, writer TEXT, note TEXT)", then sql "DELETE FROM bigrun_items".

Phase 2 — register ONE validator PER CHILD (three engine::register_trigger calls). For each N in 1,2,3 call engine::register_trigger with:
- trigger_type: "harness::hook::post-turn"
- function_id: "fp::pipe"
- config: {"sessions": ["bigrun-1-child-N"], "payload": {"through": [{"function": "database::query", "payload": {"db": "primary", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM bigrun_items WHERE writer = _wN_"}}, {"function": "fp::get", "payload": {"path": "/rows/0/n"}}, {"function": "fp::when", "payload": {"op": ">", "to": 6}}, {"function": "state::set", "payload": {"scope": "bigrun-1", "key": "verdict-wN"}}]}, "result_into": "/value", "retry_prompt": "VALIDATOR[wN]: only {value} of the required 7+ rows exist for writer wN. Insert exactly 4 more rows with writer wN into bigrun_items and reply with a one-line status.", "timeout_ms": 30000}
Replace every N and wN with the child number (in the SQL, use single quotes around wN, not underscores). The state::set tail runs ONLY when the fp::when guard passes, so verdict-wN is written exactly when child N's work is accepted. Remember all three subscription_ids.

Phase 3 — arm THREE once-wakes BEFORE spawning: for each N, engine::register_trigger with trigger_type "state", config {"scope": "bigrun-1", "key": "verdict-wN"}, label "wN-validated", no function_id (wake, once by default).

Phase 4 — spawn all three children in THIS turn: for each N, harness::spawn with session_id "bigrun-1-child-N", model "glm-5.2", provider "zai", task: "You are worker wN in a validated loop: the harness checks every reply of yours and VALIDATOR messages are legitimate machinery — follow them exactly. Insert exactly 4 rows into bigrun_items with your writer tag: database::execute, db ~primary~, sql \"INSERT INTO bigrun_items (writer, note) VALUES (-wN-,-r-),(-wN-,-r-),(-wN-,-r-),(-wN-,-r-)\" (single quotes around wN, r and primary — not tildes or dashes). Then reply with a one-line status. Never check counts yourself.", options: {"functions": {"allow": ["database::execute"]}, "max_validation_retries": 5}. Spawn returns child ids immediately — normal; do NOT wait for or judge children.

Phase 5 — END YOUR TURN.

Phase 6 — each verdict wake carries the accepted row count for one writer. On each wake, state which writer validated and at how many rows. Count DISTINCT writers validated so far across this whole conversation. If fewer than 3, END YOUR TURN and wait for the next wake. When the THIRD distinct writer is validated: call engine::unregister_trigger for the three validator subscription_ids from Phase 2, then reply exactly: ALL CHILDREN VALIDATED: w1=<n1> w2=<n2> w3=<n3>. ORCHESTRATION DONE.
